jobs.description:
Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done? For a family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a versatile warehouse worker who can be flexibly deployed across different departments and enjoys taking on a variety of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Assemble wooden crates for shipping large machine parts. 

- Pack parts manually and using machines. 

- Process and register documents and information in the computer system. 

- Support colleagues across different departments where needed.

- You enjoy combining physical work with administrative tasks and can easily switch between the two.

- You speak and understand English well.

- You work accurately, are flexible and have a hands-on mentality.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a Warehouse Operator for a company in Lokeren. 

You will be responsible for checking, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work daytime hours in a technical working environment with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 

- Check technical drawings and verify that all parts are complete. 

- Carry out small tasks such as removing rust and touch-up painting. 

- Prepare parts for shipment. 

- Process and register parts using the internal computer system.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking.

- You work accurately and in a structured way, with an eye for detail.

- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems.

- You are a hands-on team player and speak Dutch or English

Do you like working accurately and enjoy a practical job? For the same family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing. 

- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications. 

- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form. 

- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand English.

- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg.

- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately.

- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ? Join us today as SAP BC Consultant (Medior/Senior) and help our customers by maintaining a well-functioning, reliable, and secure SAP environment that supports the organization's business processes effectively.

YOUR ROLE

• System Administration: installation, configuration, and monitoring the system, ensuring a correctly set up and aligned system with the business requirements
• Performance Monitoring: optimize system performance and enhance overall efficiency

• System Upgrades and Patch Management: to keep the system current and running smoothly
• 
Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: diagnose problems, perform root cause analysis, and apply corrective actions to ensure system stability and minimize downtime

 

YOUR PROFILE

• A bachelor's or master's degree combined with 4+ years of SAP project experience

• Practical knowledge in system installation, configuration, and maintenance
• Hands-on experience with Cloud and Hybrid landscapes (SAP BTP or IaaS)
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude

You will join the BC team that really fosters a culture of collaboration. Every member contributes to achieving common goals. Support is at the core of its interactions, ensuring that everyone feels valued and encouraged in their efforts. Trust is a foundational element within the team, promoting open communication and the confidence to take on challenges.

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following: 
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

jobs.occupation: Production Operator - 2 shifts - English or Dutch - Bredene
jobs.description:
In this role as a production worker, you are the central link in the production line. You receive deliveries, set up machines, start them up, and ensure everything runs smoothly. You organize the work on your line like a conductor leading a small production symphony.

As a Production Operator - 2 shifts you monitor quality, record data, and resolve minor malfunctions independently. For more technical issues, the technical department is there to support you. Naturally, you work according to hygiene, safety, and quality regulations — after all, chocolate deserves respect.

 

Do you already see yourself in this role as a production worker? Then this will sound familiar: you work independently, have technical insight, and follow food safety regulations without hesitation. A production worker who fits here values order, hygiene, and clear instructions. Do you speak Dutch or English? Perfect — then you have everything you need to get started.

jobs.occupation: AI Agent Engineer – AI & Security Operations
jobs.description:

• Manage the full AI agent lifecycle from initial identification and design through to deployment and continuous improvement.
• Build and maintain AI agents that support concrete security operations use cases such as threat intelligence gathering and enrichment.
• Identify emerging opportunities where AI can create measurable value and validate these ideas through structured experimentation.
• Translate complex cybersecurity and security operations challenges into practical, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions.
• Collaborate closely with security analysts and engineers to refine requirements, validate outcomes, and support the adoption of new tools.
• Establish sustainable handover processes and technical documentation to enable long-term operational support by the security team.

Requirements

• You bring 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity disciplines such as Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, or Incident Response.
• You possess proven experience designing and delivering AI-enabled solutions within an enterprise environment.
• You have experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready technical solutions.
• You're able to work independently and take full ownership of projects from concept through implementation and handover.
• You possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to translate operational requirements into scalable solutions.
• You have excellent communication skills for collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a multidisciplinary environment.

jobs.occupation: Digital Risk & Compliance Officer – GRC & Security Frameworks
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with organizational goals.
• Conduct structured risk assessments across IT systems and third-party vendors using frameworks such as CIS18, ISO 27001, or NIST.
• Monitor the threat landscape to proactively identify and mitigate emerging risks relevant to the project.
• Contribute to internal and external IT audits and test the effectiveness of digital controls.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed security and compliance requirements into operational processes and digital projects.
• Implement pragmatic security controls and build digital risk awareness courses for employees.
• Assess the risk profiles and compliance posture of critical SaaS vendors and digital partners.

Requirements

• You bring 1+ years of experience in information security, IT risk management, or a related discipline.
• You possess practical knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, CIS18, and NIST CSF.
• You have a solid understanding of regulatory requirements including GDPR, NIS2, and the EU AI Act.
• You're experienced in conducting vendor risk assessments and collaborating on IT audits.
• You have a technical understanding of Azure cloud governance, Microsoft 365, and hybrid infrastructure.
• You possess knowledge of Identity & Access Management concepts including RBAC, PAM, MFA, and Entra ID.
• You bring familiarity with vulnerability management processes and tooling such as Qualys or Tenable.
• You are fluent in French and English.
Nice to Haves

• Possession of ISO 27001 Foundation, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or CompTIA Security+ certifications.
• Experience setting up an ISMS or GRC platform to manage controls and risks.
• Understanding of secure software development practices and application-level risks.
• Knowledge of Dutch.

• Assess impacts on existing architecture and define target evolutions aligned with enterprise strategy and standards.
• Define and document functional flows, system interactions, and business rules using architecture diagrams.
